inv.location: Calle del Vallespir, Sants, Sants-Montjuïc, Barcelona
inv.desc_es:
Finques Feliu del grupo Housfy, alquila local en Sant-Montjuïc, en Barcelona. La propiedad cuenta con 245 m² de superficie construida, 190 m2 útiles (verificados con la Dirección General de Catastro), construido en 2000.

GRAN OPORTUNIDAD. Local comercial en edificio rehabilitado en calle Vallespir (Sants) a pie de calle, de 167 m2 en planta y 79 m2 altillo. Tiene un patio interior que da ventilación al local. El altillo dispone de una cocina. Acceso desde la calle y por puerta en el vestíbulo de la finca. En perfecto estado de conservación. La altura del techo de la planta baja es de 2,98m y la del altillo es de 2,06m.
Situado en punto estratégico comercial, cercano a la Estación de Sants (metro, Renfe y Ave), Plaza del Centro e integrado dentro del eje comercial de Sants-Les Corts.

VALOR AÑADIDO, mantiene todo su mobiliario e instalaciones ya que anteriormente era un despacho, manteniendo todo su mobiliario e instalaciones. Apto para cualquier negocio con la posibilidad de diáfano.

Estado del inmueble:
Buen estado.

Distribución y estancias principales:
Varios despachos separados por mamparas y tabiques.
Dos aseos.

Características principales:
Aire acondicionado con bomba de calor.
Escaparate de 3,92m.
Patio interior.
Altillo practicable.

Sobre la zona:
Su estratégica ubicación, en una de las zonas más consolidadas y en auge del barrio, aseguran una clientela constante. A pocos minutos del metro de Plaça del Centre o Sants Estació. Próximo a puntos clave de la ciudad, este local reune todos los ingredientes para un negocio de éxito. Excelente conectividad con transporte público, tiendas, restaurantes y todos los servicios esenciales.

Servicios:
Este local cuenta con los suministros de luz y agua de alta.

Condiciones:
Total alquiler 2.950€/mes + iva
2 meses de fianza
2 meses de garantía adicional
Contrato de 5 años o a valorar.
Cumplimiento de estancia mínima de 1 año.
Honorarios de agencia, una mensualidad más iva.

Certificado Energético Nº registro Q3MN9**** en vigor hasta 16/12/2034

En cumplimiento de la Ley 8/2026 en Cataluña, el certificado de presencia o ausencia de amianto se encuentra en proceso de tramitación.

¿Quieres visitarlo? Contacta con Finques Del Pallars del Grupo Housfy y agenda tu visita sin compromiso. Más información en: feliu.es

inv.desc_en:
Finques Feliu, part of the Housfy group, rents a commercial space in Sants-Montjuïc, Barcelona. The property has 245 m² of built area, 190 m² of usable area (verified by the General Directorate of Cadastre), built in 2000.

GREAT OPPORTUNITY. Commercial space in a renovated building on Vallespir Street (Sants) at street level, with 167 m² on the ground floor and a 79 m² mezzanine. It has an interior patio that provides ventilation to the premises. The mezzanine has a kitchen. Access from the street and through a door in the building's lobby. In perfect condition. The ceiling height on the ground floor is 2.98m and the mezzanine is 2.06m.
Located in a strategic commercial point, close to Sants Station (metro, Renfe, and Ave), Plaza del Centro, and integrated into the Sants-Les Corts commercial hub.

ADDED VALUE: It retains all its furniture and installations as it was previously an office. Suitable for any business with the possibility of an open-plan layout.

Property condition:
Good condition.

Distribution and main rooms:
Several offices separated by partitions and walls.
Two restrooms.

Main features:
Air conditioning with heat pump.
3.92m storefront.
Interior patio.
Usable mezzanine.

About the area:
Its strategic location, in one of the most consolidated and booming areas of the neighborhood, ensures a constant clientele. A few minutes from the Plaça del Centre or Sants Estació metro stations. Close to key points of the city, this space has all the ingredients for a successful business. Excellent connectivity with public transport, shops, restaurants, and all essential services.

Services:
This space has electricity and water supplies connected.

Conditions:
Total rent €2,950/month + VAT
2 months deposit
2 months additional guarantee
5-year contract or to be assessed.
Minimum stay of 1 year.
Agency fees, one month's rent plus VAT.

Energy Certificate Registration No. Q3MN9**** valid until

In compliance with Law 8/2026 in Catalonia, the certificate of presence or absence of asbestos is in the process of being processed.

Do you want to visit it? Contact Finques Del Pallars of the Housfy Group and schedule your visit without obligation. More information at: feliu.es

Warning regarding permitted uses: The offeror has not verified the possible limitations of use or activity that could derive from the statutes of the community of owners. It is entirely up to the potential tenant to carry out the appropriate checks to ensure that the intended use of the property complies with said community regulations, exempting the advertiser from any responsibility in this regard.

Legal notice:
Housfy is a technological platform that offers the owner all the services necessary to rent the property on their own. For your safety, we never charge fees or reservations for rental properties before signing the reservation contract. For more information, visit us at AICAT number: 7922.

About us:
Housfy is the comprehensive real estate services platform. Our combination of experts and technology makes comfortable, clear, and secure services available to everyone. AICAT number: 7922.
For your safety, we never charge fees or reservations for rental properties before signing the reservation contract.
